newsitem.title: USA: Motorola expands board by one member.
newsitem.headline: Motorola expands board by one member.

text.p: Motorola Inc said Tuesday it elected Robert Growney, its president and chief operating officer, to its board of directors, expanding the size of its board to 17 members.

Growney was named president and chief operating officer January 1. He was previously executive vice president of Motorola and president and general manager of the Messaging, Information and Media Sector, the company said.
Motorola markets semiconductors and telecommunications devices. The company's stock closed up 7/8 to 67-5/8.
